# QR encoder

`qrcodegen.js` is the browser JavaScript QR Code generator by Project Nayuki,
downloaded from the [official library page](https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library).
The original MIT copyright and permission notice is preserved in the file.
It is served locally, without a CDN or external QR service.

Source: https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js

The independent `jsqr` decoder is a development-only test dependency, licensed
under Apache-2.0. It is not served by the panel and is not needed on a server.

SHA-256 of the vendored encoder: `2511bc17f40a3c41d4a0578995db956b38997334d3d20113a5d4dc5c49c69480`
